name: Tooltip
summary: A small dark label that appears on hover or keyboard focus of a control, CSS only.
useWhen: Naming an icon-only button in a toolbar (Bold, Insert image, Preview).
A short, non-essential hint about what a control does ("Saves your draft locally").
Showing the keyboard shortcut of an action (Save · ⌘S).

dontUseWhen.case: Content with links or buttons, or anything people need to read carefully
Information needed to complete the task (format rules, errors)
Truncated table text that people need to read
dontUseWhen.use: wider column, wrapping, or a detail view

anatomy.description: Inline wrapper (position: relative, inline-flex) around the trigger and the bubble. The trigger is a focusable element (button, link) placed first; the bubble shows on :hover or :focus-within.
The label. Must be the last child of the wrapper. Dark surface, 12px text, no line wrap by default, arrow drawn with ::after. Above the trigger when no placement modifier is set.

attributes.id: Unique; referenced by aria-describedby on the trigger

anatomy.description: Keyboard shortcut chip after the label text (e.g. ⌘S).

modifiers.description: Max width 380px (two short sentences). Use with --multiline.
Lets text wrap at the max width (default is one line, no wrap).
Turns pointer events back on so links inside can be clicked. Avoid: see rules and known issues.

states.name: visible
states.how: Native :hover or :focus-within on .gds-tooltip, after --tooltip-delay-show (no delay with reduced motion).

states.name: forced open
states.how: Add is-open to .gds-tooltip (docs and JS-controlled tooltips). is-open is a shared global class, so it is not listed as a modifier here (see known issues).

a11y: Bubble: role="tooltip" and a unique id. Trigger: aria-describedby="<bubble id>".
The trigger must be focusable so keyboard users get the tooltip on focus (:focus-within).
An icon-only trigger needs its own aria-label; the tooltip describes, it does not name.
Never put the only copy of important information in a tooltip: touch screens have no hover.
The bubble ignores the pointer by default and closes when focus or pointer leaves; it cannot be dismissed with Escape (CSS only).

rules.rule: The bubble has role="tooltip" and an id; the trigger inside the same wrapper has aria-describedby with that id.
rules.why: Without the link, screen reader users never hear the tooltip.

rules.rule: The first child of .gds-tooltip is a focusable element (button, a[href], input).
rules.why: The bubble shows on :focus-within; a span or icon trigger never gets focus, so keyboard users never see it.

rules.rule: An icon-only trigger has its own aria-label, even with a tooltip.
rules.why: aria-describedby adds a description, not a name; the button would be announced as just "button".

rules.rule: The bubble is the last child of .gds-tooltip.
rules.why: The show selector uses the child combinator and the stacking assumes the bubble comes after the trigger.

rules.rule: No links or buttons inside the bubble; do not use --interactive. Use a popover for interactive content.
rules.why: role="tooltip" must not contain controls, and a hover-only surface is hard to reach with keyboard, touch and screen readers.

rules.rule: Keep tooltip text to one short phrase. Longer text needs --multiline (and --md or --lg); more than two sentences belongs in a popover or on the page.
rules.why: Without --multiline the text does not wrap and runs past the bubble; long tooltips disappear before people finish reading.
rules.removeInV3: Wrap text by default so the size modifiers work without --multiline.

rules.rule: Tooltips hold only extra help. Labels, errors and rules people need go in visible text.
rules.why: Touch screens cannot hover, and the tooltip is hidden by default.

knownIssues.issue: WCAG 1.4.13 (content on hover or focus): the CSS-only bubble cannot be dismissed with Escape, and with pointer-events: none it closes when the pointer moves onto it.
knownIssues.fix: Add a tooltip mode to the ds-core controller (Escape to close, hoverable bubble), and keep the CSS version for simple labels.

knownIssues.issue: --interactive puts links inside an element with role="tooltip", which ARIA does not allow, and the docs show it as a supported pattern.
Placement is pure CSS: no flip near the viewport edges, only the width is clamped. Bubbles near the top or a scrolling container edge get cut off.
knownIssues.fix: Use createPopover() with role "tooltip" for flip / shift, or CSS anchor positioning later.

knownIssues.issue: The size modifiers only set max-width, but the default white-space: nowrap means they have no visible effect without --multiline.
is-open (forced open) breaks the BEM naming rule and is also used by the table action-cell dropdown, so it cannot belong to one contract.
Placement uses physical left / right, so --left and --right do not flip in right-to-left layouts.
knownIssues.fix: Use logical properties (inset-inline-start / end) and name the modifiers --start / --end.
